info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking It Management Platform Operation By Platform Operation Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve detailed information about a specific banking IT management platform operation by its unique identifier. It serves as a crucial resource for IT professionals and developers managing banking systems, providing insights into platform operations and their statuses. Typical consumers include system integrators, developers, and IT support staff seeking operational data for troubleshooting and reporting. Utilize this API to gather essential operational metrics and enhance the management of banking IT solutions.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information regarding a specific platform operation identified by its unique resource ID. It provides insights into the operation's current status and related metadata.

requestBody.description: Request Body for retrieving operational details specific to RES-100045 in the IT management platform. Ensure that the request includes all required fields defined in the schema to successfully fetch the relevant data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the desired resource.
